title: feat(plugin-audit): AuditPluginOptions.getLocale, a host locale resolver asked before the settings-derived locale
body:
Fixes #22318
Clause-②: yes (widening)

Executes ruling D as the card quotes it (objectstack-ai/cloud#2435 item 14, director record `6063207364`): `plugin-audit` gains one optional host option, a locale resolver, consulted first and falling back to the settings-derived locale when it answers nothing. Dispatched under claim `6064241770` (session `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ`).

## What changes

- **`AuditPluginOptions.getLocale`** (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`), typed `(tenantId?: string, userId?: string) => string | undefined | Promise of (string | undefined)`. The name is the ruling's own spelling and the name of the writer-layer seam it feeds (`installAuditWriters`' `getLocale`).
- **The plugin's `getLocale` closure asks it first.** A usable answer is returned; otherwise the closure runs the same `resolveLocalizationContext({ ql, settings, tenantId, userId })` read it ran before. With the option absent, the host step is never built and the closure is the old one, line for line.
- **Docs.** The option's TSDoc states the precedence (host first, settings second). The package README (`## Usage`, new subsection "Activity summary language") lists the member with its fallback table. `content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx` said "`readAudit` is the only key `AuditPluginOptions` declares", which this change makes false; that sentence now names the second key. The README carried the same sentence and is corrected in the same edit.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/plugin-audit` `minor`, additive.
- Untouched: `audit-writers.ts`, `packages/spec`. No read-time rendering, no per-organization settings, no second locale source.

## Decisions taken in this lane

- **What counts as an answer.** `undefined`, `null` and a blank string are "no answer" and fall back silently. A non-empty string is accepted when it is a well-formed BCP-47 tag (`Intl.getCanonicalLocales` accepts it), and is used in canonical form (`zh-cn` becomes `zh-CN`). Anything else (`zh_CN`, a number) falls back to the settings-derived locale and is logged once at `warn`.
  - Measured: the settings-derived locale gets no support check at this seam either. `coerceLocale` in `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` only trims it and drops a blank value. Its membership check (the `localization.locale` select options) lives at the settings write door, which a host answer never passes. A membership check against the i18n service's `getLocales()` was weighed and not taken, because providers disagree on what they serve. The memory i18n negotiates `zh` to `zh-CN`, and the file adapter looks locales up exactly, so an exact list would refuse answers a deployment does serve. A locale the i18n service has no catalog for degrades the way a settings-derived one does: to the service's declared fallback, then to the English literal. The locale is never stored on the row; it only picks the catalog.
- **A throw falls through, logged once at `warn` with the error.** Measured today: `resolveWriteLocale` (`audit-writers.ts`, the writer's memoized lookup) catches a throwing `getLocale` and answers no locale, so a throw left to propagate would give English summaries for that scope, silently. Catching it in the plugin limits a host fault to the host's half: the settings locale still applies, and the audited write lands. "Once" is per install, because the writer asks per tenant/user scope and a broken resolver would otherwise log once per scope. A rejected promise is handled the same way.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin-host-locale.test.ts` (8 cases). They boot the plugin through `init`, `start` and `kernel:ready` with a real memory i18n and a settings occupant answering `ja-JP`, so the host locale, the settings fallback and English are distinguishable.

- **Pin:** with `getLocale` answering `zh-CN`, a create writes `sys_activity.summary` = `创建了 Qualification "OC-00001"`, and the resolver is asked with `('org-1', 'user-1')`.
- A synchronous ` zh-cn ` answer counts and is canonicalized.
- **Fallback:** `undefined`, `null` and a blank string give the settings-derived Japanese summary, with no warning.
- **Absent:** no option, and `{}`, give the settings-derived summary. No option and no settings service gives English.
- **Throw:** two scopes, two throws, both summaries in the settings locale, both ledger rows written, exactly one `warn` carrying `{ err: 'locale store unreachable' }`. A rejected promise behaves the same way.
- **Malformed:** `zh_CN` gives the settings locale and one `warn` naming the answer.

Runs at `5fc8c76371`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 42 passed (42)`, `Tests 657 passed (657)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck`: exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck: OK … 0 file(s) / 0 error(s)`.

## Ablation: the plugin ignores the option

Run on committed head `723b1f599e` through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which holds the restore on a trap. The anchor `if (readHostLocale) {` (hit once) became `if (readHostLocale && false) {`.

- The tool's on-disk proof: `anchor x1 -> x0`, `replace x0 -> x1`, blob `d346f4403902` became `26dbb44c82f3`.
- `audit-plugin-host-locale.test.ts`: `Tests 5 failed | 3 passed (8)`. The pin received `Qualification「OC-00001」を作成しました` (the settings locale) where it expected the Chinese summary. The canonical, throw, rejected and malformed cases also went red. The fallback and absent cases stayed green, as expected, because they do not depend on the option.
- Restore: `blob after restore d346f4403902 == blob at HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. An independent `git hash-object` gave the same answer.
- No `dist/` step was needed. The test imports `./audit-plugin.js` relatively, so vitest reads the source.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `5fc8c76371` (after merging `origin/main`) derived 95 commands. All 95 ran. 92 exited 0 on the first pass.
  - Three refused at the first pass with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3): `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`. Each exited 0 after a workspace build.
  - `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 95 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Roster families whose roster sits under a touched directory, plus two named by the card's kind: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:published-readme-exports` and `check:engine-double-contract`. All exit 0.
- **Lint, narrowed and declared:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the two changed `.ts` files reports 2 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. A file eslint ignored would show a warning, so 0 warnings means both were linted.
  - The population read from `eslint.config.mjs`: `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`, so the `.md`/`.mdx` edits are outside it.
  - The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- `AuditPluginOptions` is not re-exported from the package index, as before this change. A host can pass an object literal, but can name the type only through `ConstructorParameters` of `AuditPlugin`. Not changed here. Noted, not filed; carrier: none.
- `resolveWriteLocale` in `audit-writers.ts` swallows a throwing `getLocale` without a log. The plugin's own closure no longer reaches that path for a host fault, because `resolveLocalizationContext` never throws and the host step catches. A direct caller of the exported `installAuditWriters` still can. Noted, not filed; carrier: none.
